 San Antonio Spurs 123 – 95 HT Portland Trail Blazers Live Updated a few seconds ago Spurs vs Trail Blazers LIVE, Score Updates and Highlights in NBA Game (123-95)
 Follow San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers live score, starting lineups, box score stats, standings & play-by-play updates in NBA 2026 on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 8, 2026, 12:28 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 12:28 AM ET Nov 8 12:28 AM ET a few seconds ago 4Q | 2:57: Jordan McLaughlin hits three as Spurs hold 123-95 lead over Blazers
 Jordan McLaughlin knocked down a three-pointer assisted by Tarris Reed Jr. to push the San Antonio Spurs ahead of the Portland Trail Blazers, 123-95. After Chris Youngblood missed a 26-foot pullup jumper at 3:36 and Tarris Reed Jr. committed an offensive foul at 3:29, Keldon Johnson grabbed a defensive rebound off Jayson Kent's missed 27-foot three at 3:15 before Jayson Kent stole a pass at 2:57.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 11:21 PM ET Halftime: Victor Wembanyama scores 16 points… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google Nov 8 12:22 AM ET 6 minutes ago 4Q | 5:08: Jayson Kent scores on fast break as Spurs lead Blazers 120-93
 After Jordan McLaughlin grabbed a defensive rebound at 5:36 and Harrison Barnes missed a 27-foot three-pointer at 5:21, Chris Youngblood stole a pass from Keldon Johnson at the 5:17 mark and assisted Jayson Kent on a running layup at 5:13. Following a shooting foul by Yang Hansen at 5:08, Keldon Johnson hit one of two free throws to put the San Antonio Spurs ahead 120-93 over the Portland Trail Blazers.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Nov 8 12:17 AM ET 11 minutes ago 4Q | 6:45: Harrison Barnes and Yang Hansen trade threes as Spurs lead 116-85
 Harrison Barnes hit a three-pointer assisted by Luke Kornet and added a driving finish off a pass from Keldon Johnson, while Yang Hansen answered with a 26-foot three-pointer set up by Chris Youngblood. After Jordan McLaughlin missed from 26 feet at 7:04 and Branden Carlson missed a 23-foot three at 6:52, Youngblood committed a shooting foul with 6:45 left in the fourth quarter and the San Antonio Spurs ahead 116-85.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Nov 8 12:10 AM ET 18 minutes ago 4Q | 9:44: Branden Carlson scores on driving layup as Spurs lead Blazers 111-80
 Micah Potter came away with a steal on a bad pass by Carter Bryant at the 10:10 mark, setting up Branden Carlson for a driving layup at 10:01. After Keldon Johnson missed a shot at 9:49, Yang Hansen secured the defensive rebound with the San Antonio Spurs leading the Portland Trail Blazers 111-80 at 9:44 of the fourth quarter. Victor Wembanyama leads San Antonio with 29 points and seven rebounds.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Nov 8 12:05 AM ET 23 minutes ago End of 3Q: Julian Champagnie hits late three as Spurs take 109-76 lead into fourth
 Keldon Johnson grabbed a defensive rebound at 29.7 seconds before dishing an assist to Julian Champagnie, who knocked down a 23-foot three-pointer with 6.2 seconds remaining. After a personal foul by Harrison Barnes at 4.6 seconds, Scoot Henderson sank two free throws for the Portland Trail Blazers. Dylan Harper missed a 33-foot pull-up three-pointer at the buzzer as the San Antonio Spurs took a 109-76 lead at the end of the third quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Nov 8 12:04 AM ET 24 minutes ago 3Q | 24.3: Dylan Harper hits step-back three as Spurs stretch lead to 106-74
 Keldon Johnson grabbed an offensive rebound off Luke Kornet's missed alley-oop dunk at 1:15 and scored a two-point basket at 1:09. Micah Potter answered with a 24-foot three-pointer assisted by Yang Hansen at 59.5, before Dylan Harper nailed a 26-foot step-back triple at 38.7. Keldon Johnson then rebounded Scoot Henderson's missed 27-foot pull-up three at 29.7 as the San Antonio Spurs lead the Portland Trail Blazers, 106-74, with 24.3 seconds left in the third quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:58 PM ET 30 minutes ago 3Q | 2:15: Dylan Harper converts putback as Spurs hold 99-69 lead over Blazers
 Dylan Harper corralled an offensive rebound at 3:02 and converted a two-point basket at the 2:59 mark to extend the San Antonio Spurs' advantage over the Portland Trail Blazers to 99-69 with 2:15 left in the third quarter. Keldon Johnson and Sidy Cissoko then traded steals at 2:43 and 2:34 before Deni Avdija missed a running layup at 2:29 and Harper missed a 24-foot three-pointer at 2:20.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:53 PM ET 35 minutes ago 3Q | 5:05: Victor Wembanyama and Dylan Harper score inside as Spurs lead 91-64
 After Jrue Holiday missed a 24-foot step-back three-pointer at 5:56, Victor Wembanyama grabbed the defensive rebound and converted a 1-foot shot at the 5:47 mark to reach 29 points on 9-of-13 shooting. Following a missed 24-foot three-pointer by Yang Hansen at 5:27, Dylan Harper finished a driving layup at 5:16 to extend the San Antonio Spurs' lead over the Portland Trail Blazers to 91-64 with 5:05 left in the third quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:46 PM ET 42 minutes ago 3Q | 7:17: Victor Wembanyama buries 25-foot three as Spurs push lead to 84-59
 After De'Aaron Fox stole a pass from Damian Lillard at 7:49, Victor Wembanyama corralled Stephon Castle's missed running layup and threw down a tip-in dunk at 7:42. Devin Vassell then pulled down the defensive rebound on Scoot Henderson's missed 25-foot jumper, setting up Wembanyama's 25-foot three-pointer at the 7:17 mark to give the San Antonio Spurs an 84-59 lead over the Portland Trail Blazers. Wembanyama now has 27 points on 8-of-11 shooting alongside six rebounds and three assists.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:42 PM ET an hour ago 3Q | 8:34: The Spurs lead 76-57 in the 3rd quarter
 Damian Lillard splashed a deep 29-foot triple, before Victor Wembanyama threw down an alley-oop finish at the rim off a crisp feed from Stephon Castle . Moments later, Stephon Castle splashed a catch-and-shoot three off a crisp feed from Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox buried a three-pointer set up by Victor Wembanyama , leaving the scoreboard at Spurs 76, Trail Blazers 57 with 8:34 remaining in the 3rd Quarter. On the stat sheet, Victor Wembanyama (20 PTS, 5-8 FG, 2-4 3PT, 4 REB, 3 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK) paces the Spurs while Deni Avdija (13 PTS, 4-10 FG, 2-3 3PT, 4 REB, 1 AST, 1 STL) leads the Trail Blazers.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:35 PM ET an hour ago 3Q | 11:03: Stephon Castle scores inside off Victor Wembanyama assist
 Stephon Castle converted a 1-foot shot assisted by Victor Wembanyama at the 11:13 mark to put the San Antonio Spurs ahead of the Portland Trail Blazers, 66-49, with 11:03 left in the third quarter. Earlier in the period, Deni Avdija missed a two-point attempt at 11:45 and Victor Wembanyama missed a 25-foot three-pointer at 11:34. De'Aaron Fox then forced a Deni Avdija turnover at 11:17 to set up the fast-break basket.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:31 PM ET an hour ago Halftime Leaders: Victor Wembanyama and Deni Avdija top first-half scoring as Spurs lead 64-49
 Victor Wembanyama paces the San Antonio Spurs at the break with 16 points on 3-of-4 shooting and 2-of-2 from three-point range, while Julian Champagnie adds 11 points on 3-of-6 shooting from deep and Stephon Castle contributes nine points, seven rebounds, and four assists. For the Portland Trail Blazers, who trail 64-49 at halftime, Deni Avdija leads the team with 10 points and three rebounds, followed by Damian Lillard with nine points and Scoot Henderson with seven points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:26 PM ET an hour ago Halftime Stats: Spurs hit 10 three-pointers to build 64-49 advantage over Trail Blazers
 The San Antonio Spurs hold a 64-49 halftime lead after shooting 17-of-45 from the field (38%) and knocking down 10-of-23 from three-point range (43%). San Antonio also recorded 27 rebounds and 14 assists across the opening two quarters. Meanwhile, the Portland Trail Blazers went 15-of-44 overall (34%) and 3-of-17 from beyond the arc (18%), finishing the first half with 22 rebounds and 6 assists.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:21 PM ET an hour ago Halftime: Victor Wembanyama scores 16 points as Spurs lead Trail Blazers 64-49
 Victor Wembanyama split two free throws with 30.5 seconds left in the second quarter after a loose ball foul on Deni Avdija, who answered with a driving layup at 19.5 seconds. De'Aaron Fox missed a driving floating jump shot at the buzzer as the San Antonio Spurs took a 64-49 halftime lead over the Portland Trail Blazers. Victor Wembanyama leads all scorers with 16 points and 3 rebounds, while Deni Avdija has 10 points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:19 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 30.6: Victor Wembanyama reaches 14 points as Spurs widen lead to 63-47
 Victor Wembanyama sank two free throws with 1:01 left in the second quarter after a foul on Chris Youngblood, lifting his game-high total to 14 points on 3-of-4 shooting. Jrue Holiday missed a layup at the 44.8 mark, and Dylan Harper grabbed the defensive rebound before misfiring on a 25-foot three-pointer. The San Antonio Spurs collected the offensive board and drew a loose ball foul on Deni Avdija to lead the Portland Trail Blazers 63-47 at 30.6.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:14 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 2:55: Victor Wembanyama hits two free throws as Spurs lead 52-38
 Victor Wembanyama knocked down a pair of free throws at the 3:12 mark following a loose ball foul on Toumani Camara, putting the San Antonio Spurs ahead of the Portland Trail Blazers 52-38 with 2:55 left in the second quarter. De'Aaron Fox was then whistled for a shooting foul at 2:55 as Deni Avdija, Chris Youngblood, and Dylan Harper checked into the game. Wembanyama leads San Antonio with 12 points and three rebounds.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:13 PM ET an hour ago Live box score check (2:55 - 2nd): San Antonio Spurs 52-38 Portland Trail Blazers
 San Antonio Spurs 52-38 Portland Trail Blazers (2:55 - 2nd): Live statistical snapshot as play continues.
 Portland Trail Blazers: Deni Avdija (8), Damian Lillard (2) | San Antonio Spurs: Victor Wembanyama (12), De'Aaron Fox (4)
 Spurs: Field Goal %: 35 · Three Point %: 40 · Rebounds: 26 | Trail Blazers: Field Goal %: 29 · Three Point %: 7 · Rebounds: 21
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:07 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 3:39: Luke Kornet and Stephon Castle push Spurs lead to 46-37
 De'Aaron Fox split two free throws and Luke Kornet made a pair at the line before Toumani Camara converted a driving finish assisted by Scoot Henderson. Stephon Castle added two free throws as the San Antonio Spurs built a 46-37 lead over the Portland Trail Blazers with 3:39 left in the second quarter. After Jrue Holiday committed an offensive foul turnover at 3:45, Keldon Johnson missed a 25-foot three-pointer at 3:41.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:01 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 5:10: Devin Vassell and Dylan Harper extend Spurs lead to 41-33
 Dylan Harper converted a driving layup off a pass from Carter Bryant, Scoot Henderson answered in the lane, and Devin Vassell hit a three-pointer assisted by Stephon Castle before Jrue Holiday sank two free throws at 5:49. Scoot Henderson blocked a 14-foot pullup jumper by Dylan Harper at 5:22, while Devin Vassell and Stephon Castle each grabbed an offensive rebound with San Antonio leading Portland 41-33 at the 5:10 mark.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:53 PM ET 2 hours ago 2Q | 8:06: Carter Bryant drains a three-pointer to give Spurs a 33-27 lead
 Sidy Cissoko scored in the paint off an assist from Damian Lillard and added a free throw before feeding Donovan Clingan for an alley-oop dunk. Carter Bryant answered with a 23-foot three-pointer assisted by De'Aaron Fox at the 8:24 mark to put the San Antonio Spurs up 33-27 over the Portland Trail Blazers. Following a personal foul by Bryant at 8:12, Scoot Henderson missed a shot at 8:06 and Portland secured the offensive team rebound.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:47 PM ET 2 hours ago 2Q | 9:57: Carter Bryant hits three-pointer as Spurs lead Trail Blazers 26-22
 Keldon Johnson grabbed a defensive rebound after Deni Avdija missed an 8-foot step-back jumper at 10:36, and Carter Bryant followed with a 23-foot three-pointer assisted by De'Aaron Fox at 10:21. Deni Avdija answered with a 3-foot shot for the Trail Blazers at 10:05, before De'Aaron Fox drew a shooting foul on Damian Lillard and made a free throw to give the Spurs a 26-22 lead at 9:57 of the second quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:40 PM ET 2 hours ago End of 1Q: Deni Avdija hits late three-pointer to cut Spurs lead to 22-20
 Julian Champagnie grabbed a defensive rebound after Donovan Clingan missed a layup at 36.2 seconds, before missing a 23-foot three-point jumper at the 24.8 mark. Deni Avdija secured the defensive board for the Portland Trail Blazers and drained a 25-foot three-pointer assisted by Damian Lillard with 2.5 seconds left. Harrison Barnes missed a heave at 0.1 as the San Antonio Spurs ended the first quarter ahead 22-20.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:39 PM ET 2 hours ago 1Q | 32.9: Damian Lillard and Jrue Holiday trim Spurs lead to 22-17
 Yang Hansen split a pair at the line and Julian Champagnie sank two free throws for San Antonio, before Jrue Holiday made two free throws at 1:31. Following missed shots by De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle, Donovan Clingan grabbed a defensive rebound at 1:11 and Damian Lillard hit a 6-foot shot at 1:00 to trim the Spurs' lead to 22-17 with 32.9 seconds left in the first quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:33 PM ET 2 hours ago 1Q | 2:21: The Spurs lead 20-12 in the 1st quarter
 Stephon Castle knocked down a jumper, while Yang Hansen converted in the paint, as San Antonio Spurs holds a 20–12 lead (2:21, 1st Quarter). On the stat sheet, Victor Wembanyama (8 PTS, 3-4 FG, 2-2 3PT, 2 REB, 1 STL) paces the Spurs while Deni Avdija (3 PTS, 0-1 FG, 2 REB, 1 AST, 1 STL) leads the Trail Blazers.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:26 PM ET 2 hours ago 1Q | 5:07: Devin Vassell steal and layup extend Spurs lead to 18-10
 Luke Kornet hit a 7-foot floating jump shot at 5:54 off an assist from Devin Vassell after Stephon Castle secured a defensive rebound. Vassell then intercepted a Deni Avdija pass at 5:43 and scored a running layup at 5:40 for the San Antonio Spurs. Scoot Henderson answered with a two-point jumper at 5:25, making it 18-10 for San Antonio over the Portland Trail Blazers at 5:07.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:21 PM ET 2 hours ago 1Q | 7:47: Stephon Castle and Victor Wembanyama push Spurs ahead 11-5
 Stephon Castle knocked down a 26-foot three-pointer off an assist from Dylan Harper, and Victor Wembanyama followed with a 27-foot three-pointer assisted by Devin Vassell plus a driving layup at 8:29. Damian Lillard answered for the Portland Trail Blazers at 8:09 with a 14-foot driving floater to make it 11-5 with 7:47 remaining in the first quarter. Wembanyama leads the San Antonio Spurs with 8 points on 3-of-4 shooting and 2 rebounds.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:15 PM ET 2 hours ago 1Q | 10:27: Victor Wembanyama drains a 25-foot three as Spurs lead 3-1
 San Antonio Spurs center Victor Wembanyama connected on a 25-foot three-point jumper off an assist from De'Aaron Fox at the 10:46 mark after Deni Avdija committed an out-of-bounds bad pass turnover at 10:57. Earlier at 11:07, Stephon Castle missed a 25-foot three-pointer that Deni Avdija collected for a defensive rebound. Following a missed two-point shot by Deni Avdija and a shooting foul on Devin Vassell, Scoot Henderson missed his first free throw at 10:27 with the scoreboard at 3-1.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:10 PM ET 2 hours ago Starters set on the court for San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers: Opening units take position for first-quarter tip-off at Moda Center
 Starting lineups have been announced at Moda Center in Portland as the opening units for the 7-2 San Antonio Spurs and the 6-2 Portland Trail Blazers take their positions on the floor for first-quarter tip-off at 0-0. Victor Wembanyama (29.0 points, 12.4 rebounds) and De'Aaron Fox (6.1 assists) headline the Spurs roster against Portland leaders Deni Avdija (23.4 points, 6.4 assists) and Donovan Clingan (10.6 rebounds) with referees Bill Kennedy, Tre Maddox, and Dannica Baroody officiating.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:02 PM ET 2 hours ago 15 minutes to tip-off for San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers: Bill Kennedy, Tre Maddox, and Dannica Baroody assigned to officiate at Moda Center
 Tip-off for the first quarter between the San Antonio Spurs and the Portland Trail Blazers at Moda Center in Portland is 15 minutes away with the scoreboard at 0-0. Referees Bill Kennedy, Tre Maddox, and Dannica Baroody are the assigned officials as the 7-2 San Antonio Spurs face the 6-2 Portland Trail Blazers prior to starting lineup announcements.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:54 PM ET 3 hours ago Spurs statistical leaders: Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox
 Victor Wembanyama (#1) leads San Antonio with 29.0 points, 12.4 rebounds and 4.5 blocks per game, while guard De'Aaron Fox (#4) paces the Spurs offense with 6.1 assists per night.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:49 PM ET 3 hours ago Trail Blazers leaders: Deni Avdija, Donovan Clingan and Scoot Henderson
 Deni Avdija (#8) tops Portland with 23.4 points and 6.4 assists per game, center Donovan Clingan (#23) averages 10.6 rebounds, and Scoot Henderson (#00) joins Damian Lillard and Jrue Holiday in the active backcourt.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:38 PM ET 3 hours ago Rosters out on the court 20 minutes before San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers: Victor Wembanyama and Deni Avdija lead the scoring averages at Moda Center
 Tip-off at Moda Center in Portland is 20 minutes away with the scoreboard at 0-0 prior to the first quarter between the 7-2 San Antonio Spurs and the 6-2 Portland Trail Blazers. Victor Wembanyama leads the San Antonio Spurs into tonight's matchup at 29.1 points per game, while Deni Avdija paces the Portland Trail Blazers with averages of 23.2 points and 7.0 assists.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:30 PM ET 3 hours ago 30 minutes to tip-off: 7-2 San Antonio Spurs face 6-2 Portland Trail Blazers at Moda Center
 Tip-off at Moda Center in Portland is 30 minutes away as the 7-2 San Antonio Spurs visit the 6-2 Portland Trail Blazers on KUNP 16 with the scoreboard at 0-0 prior to the first quarter. San Antonio holds a 3-0 road record following victories over Sacramento (124-109) and Minnesota (121-111), while Portland carries a 1-1 home mark after defeating Denver (118-110) and Utah (112-90).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:16 PM ET 3 hours ago Official injury report for San Antonio and Portland
 Portland lists Shaedon Sharpe (Out), Ja Morant (Out) and Vit Krejci (Out). San Antonio lists Tobias Harris (Out) and Jayden Quaintance (Out).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta

 San Antonio Spurs and Portland Trail Blazers are set to square off at Moda Center in Portland, airing live on KUNP 16 .
 Pregame consensus line: SA -5.5 (O/U 229.5). Stay tuned here for confirmed starters and live play-by-play updates.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta

 San Antonio enters on a strong run with wins over Sacramento (124-109), Utah (117-111 OT) and Minnesota (121-111). Portland defeated Denver (118-110) and Utah (112-90) on its recent road trip.

 Star power headlines tonight's matchup between San Antonio Spurs and Portland Trail Blazers at Moda Center.
 Portland Trail Blazers statistical leaders: Deni Avdija (23.2 points) and Deni Avdija (7.0 assists).
 San Antonio Spurs statistical leaders: Victor Wembanyama (29.1 points) and De'Aaron Fox (5.9 assists).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:04 PM ET 4 hours ago Western Conference records: 7-2 Spurs visit 6-2 Trail Blazers
 The San Antonio Spurs bring a 7-2 overall record and an unbeaten 3-0 road mark into Portland, while the Portland Trail Blazers stand at 6-2 overall (1-1 at Moda Center).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:49 PM ET 5 hours ago Latest injury report and availability update: San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers
 Here is the latest pregame availability and injury report ahead of San Antonio Spurs vs Portland Trail Blazers at Moda Center (KUNP 16).
 Portland Trail Blazers injury report: Robert Williams III (C) - Out; Vit Krejci (G) - Out; Ja Morant (G) - Out; Shaedon Sharpe (G) - Out.

 Official starting lineups for the San Antonio Spurs and Portland Trail Blazers are confirmed 30 minutes before tip-off in Portland.

 7:00 PM ET 5 hours ago Tip-off time across US time zones
 Tip-off between the Spurs and Trail Blazers is scheduled for 10:00 PM ET / 9:00 PM CT / 7:00 PM PT (03:00 UTC Sunday) on Saturday night, November 7.

 Local broadcasts air on KUNP 16 / BlazerVision in Portland and FanDuel Sports Network / DAZN SAS in San Antonio, with out-of-market streaming on NBA League Pass .
